clauses.quote: there shall be no discrimination against any student by reason of race, color, national origin, creed, sex, religion, or disability regarding the identification, screening, referral, evaluation, and eligibility of potentially gifted students.
clauses.notes: Operative nondiscrimination mandate for gifted program eligibility. Primarily benefits students; mapped to management per binary constraint.

clauses.quote: All potentially gifted students shall be provided an opportunity for equal access and participation in the gifted/talented program.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the District. Benefits students.

clauses.quote: the District will notify all interested persons about the gifted/talented program by posting the policy in schools, by placing the policy in hand-books, and taking all other appropriate measures to ensure widespread dissemination and promulgation of the policy.
clauses.notes: Administrative dissemination duty regarding gifted program policy.
